Character sprites extracted from Sakura no Uta
-Sakura no Mori no Ue wo Mau- 10th Anniversary Edition.

Due to the large number of characters and the way the character sprite
resources are distributed throughout the game files, the complete sprite
set has been divided into multiple galleries.

This is Part 1 of the character sprite collection.
The remaining sprites will be included in subsequent parts.

从《サクラノ詩 ～櫻の森の上を舞う～ 10th Anniversary Edition》
游戏资源中提取的人物立绘。

由于本作角色数量较多，且人物立绘资源在游戏文件中分布较为零散，
完整立绘合集将采用分卷形式上传。

本画廊为人物立绘合集 Part 2。
其余人物立绘将在后续分卷中继续收录。
